walkthroughs.body_html:
Bacteria double every hour.

Start 100. After n hours: 100 × 2ⁿ. After 6 h: 6400. Plot — straight line on log scale.

If y ∝ 1/x and y = 4 when x = 3, then yx = 12.

When x = 6, y = 12 ÷ 6 = 2.

Speed-time graph: gradient = acceleration; area under = distance.

For 0–10 s rising from 0 to 20 m/s: distance = ½ × 10 × 20 = 100 m.

mcqs.q: y ∝ 1/x and y = 6 when x = 2. y when x = 4:

options: Distance
Speed
Acceleration
Time

mcqs.q: If 6 workers take 8 hours to paint a wall, how long would 12 workers take (assuming they work at the same rate)?
options: £24.50, by multiplying £3.50 by 7.
8 hours, because each worker still has to do the same job.
4 hours — this is inverse proportion: double the workers, halve the time.
16 hours, because doubling the workers doubles everything including the time.

mcqs.q: In a school the ratio of boys to girls is 3:2. There are 30 boys. How many girls are there?
options: There are 60 girls because girls are double the boys.
20 — each part of the ratio represents 10 pupils, so girls = 2 x 10.
There are 27 girls because the ratio 3:2 means subtracting 3 - 2 = 1 from 30 and adding to make 2 girls' part.
8 hours, because each worker still has to do the same job.

mcqs.q: If 5 pens cost £3.50, how much do 7 pens cost?
options: There are 60 girls because girls are double the boys.
£4.90 — find the unit cost (£0.70 per pen), then multiply by 7.
£5.50, by adding £2 to £3.50 because there are 2 more pens.
£24.50, by multiplying £3.50 by 7.
